title: Tangent planes and orientations of an IMRep transfer to Borel supersets of subsets of its carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1: M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient), and let B, C be Borel sets with B ⊆ M, B ⊆ C ⊆ U and Hⁿ(C ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ B there is a linear subspace Q of ℝ^P such that C has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q) and ξ(x) is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U B C : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet C → B ⊆ R.carrier → B ⊆ C → C ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (C ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict B), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient x) Q
